messages:
alina: FYI StratusGrid confirmed they can expose marketplace SKUs in Solstice-West (region sol-west-1). They can offer AMD MI300-based nodes which is great for some customers. Proposed soft open: July 14. We need SKU entitlements, marketplace listing approval, KMS connector exchange, and a quick SOC2 scoping note from StratusGrid. Who will own the entitlement ticket?

devon: I'll pick up entitlement. Need SKU IDs, initial reserved vs burst split, and projected token throughput for first 60 days.

marcus (StratusGrid): We can allocate 12x SG-SOL-MI300 (SKU: SG-SOL-MI300). For conservative planning assume 75k tokens/min peak and a 25% growth buffer. We'll upload quota form here: https://stratusgrid.partner/quotas/solstice (internal). We also have the KMS connector cert ready (fingerprint: SHA256:77AA...C33D).

jo: On product mapping: recommend 9 -> reserved pool, 3 -> burst. Note: customers asking for lower-latency inference may need dedicated placement groups; flagging potential extra entitlement for placement-group SKUs.

sam (security): Need StratusGrid SOC2 scoping answers and network segmentation details. Also require proof of key custody process for KMS. Marcus, can you drop the security questionnaire into the shared folder?

lee (legal): I'll prepare a marketplace addendum. Need to confirm indemnity and SLA language for marketplace listings. Marcus, please send the standard partner MSP and your data residency statement. If everything looks normal, I can turn the addendum around in 48h.

partners-bot: ticket PW-2042 created: "solstice-west marketplace - StratusGrid onboard" linked to INF-4219 and LEG-1021.

alina: Draft launch checklist for Thurs sync: 1) entitlement + quota numbers, 2) KMS cert & exchange test plan, 3) security questionnaire & SOC2 notes, 4) marketplace listing copy + legal signoff, 5) PR embargo window.

devon: I'll create the entitlement request today and include 75k tokens/min + 25% buffer numbers. Will note the placement-group ask as a follow-up.

marcus (StratusGrid): Uploaded security questionnaire and data residency statement to the quota form. Confirm KMS supports tangential HSM via PKCS#11. Also confirming AMI bake compatibility with our node images.

jo: Infra items: VPC peering, private endpoint for marketplace control-plane, bake AMI, security group rules for metrics ingestion. Also note Solstice-West has limited cross-region bandwidth during nightly maintenance windows; plan for staggered syncs.

infra-runner: I'll own the dry-run for peering and AMI bake. Scheduling Tue 07:30 PT dry-run, will post results to INF-4219.

sam (security): Thanks Marcus. I'll review the questionnaire today and ping for any gaps. If KMS custody docs are complete, we can greenlight the connector test.

lee (legal): Once questionnaire is reviewed, I'll loop in compliance on indemnity clauses. If placement-group SKU requires different T&Cs, I'll flag that.

alina: Communication note 1: partner marketing wants a joint blog and co-announcement but we must gate any public messaging on LEG-1021 signoff and successful infra dry-run. Proposed PR embargo until July 20.

marcus (StratusGrid): Understood. We'll hold PR until you give the go-ahead. Happy to coordinate comms with your marketing lead.

devon: ack. I'll post the entitlement ticket number when created.

partners-bot: reminder set for Thurs sync 10:00 PT.

alina: Thanks all. Please add preread to https://redwood.share/solstice-west/onboard (internal) and tag any blockers. :rocket:

marcus (StratusGrid): Will join Thurs and coordinate the KMS test window.

infra-runner: Dry-run scheduled, will post logs.

devon: closing loop later today with the entitlement submission.
